…what is going on here?

…I don't like the smell of her.

…#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.

―――Wait.
I'm pretty sure #C120200255Alice#CDEF's lips just moved…
He, lp.

…let's save her.

A hostile program other than #C236196003Caster#CDEF…!
I pick up the item that the fading monster dropped.
These… are doll parts.

I see. This is definitely a key item.

The second enemy also dropped doll parts.
This really does seem to be a key item.
It looks just like a small-scale #C236196003Caster#CDEF in a black dress.

Good morning, #[mister][miss]# meddlesome.

#RUBS     I am #RUBE#C255045045Alice#CDEF is#REND a defeated Servant.
#RUBS     I am #RUBE#C120200255Alice#CDEF is#REND a wandering specter.
Everything is but a fleeting dream to #RUBS   us#RUBE#C120200255Alice#CDEF#REND.

Ahh, but―――an evil witch caught us.
We ended up making friends with a mean person.

"Doesn't trust other people's hearts," huh?
That #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF. She's no enthusiast,
but a collector, I see.

Yes. #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF despises humans.
Yet, she loves humans who don't move.
#C236196003Caster#CDEF's body is disintegrating…!?
What!? I thought she was going to be saved…!?

#C236196003Nursery Rhyme#CDEF―――
She supported her lonely reader until
the very end.
…led by #C236196003#SVT#CDEF's words, I take the #C000246204SG#CDEF.

What's wrong, Praetor?

So, continue on #C000246204ahead#CDEF.

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,

private room.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

We climb down the stairs and run into a strange, open area.
Out of place in this eerie Labyrinth stands a beautiful garden.
In the center, surrounded by a rainbow of flowers is…

#C236196003Caster#CDEF's Master…?
She's not as upbeat as she usually is, though.

This is the white kid of the two, isn't it?
But… isn't she acting kind of odd?

…so, she was absorbed along with her Servant.
Approach her and take a look.

I agree with #C236196003#SVT#CDEF.
There's clearly something different about this garden.
Just like with the other floors,
there's no doubt that this will lead to a clue towards an #C000246204SG#CDEF…!

A familiar girl is sleeping here.
I talk to her but get no response.

…this is #C236196003Caster#CDEF's Master: #C120200255Alice#CDEF.
Back when we met her in #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF's area,
I had no recollection of her. But now I remember it all.

She was #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF's opponent in the 3rd Round:
a little girl who couldn't understand the concept of death
and was weaker than I was.

After defeating this little girl,
I advanced to the 4th Round.

…#C120200255Alice#CDEF is completely frozen.
Her eyes are transparent, as if made of quartz.
I hold her hand up, but she doesn't react.

No, she doesn't appear to be dead. The standard
is that corpses don't linger in the digital
world. Less so if they belong to a Master.

This is similar to being turned into one of
#C236196003Passionlip#CDEF's cubes. …those #C000246204Ego#CDEF bastards.
They're both too eager in seeking the macabre.

Looks like a dead body. …no, we know
her name, so this is her "corpse," I guess. It
looks like her corpse, but it isn't, it seems.

Their souls may be frozen and their bodies
may have turned into wax, but they're still
just barely alive.

She's certainly not alive.
Yet neither is she dead. This is a creature
who's been deprived of their life.

Attentively, patiently, I stand in front of #C120200255Alice#CDEF
and listen carefully.

#C120200255Alice#CDEF slowly pieces her words together, as if desperate to stack
up blocks with her shredded limbs.
Ple, ase, help, #RUBS Alice#RUBE#C255045045her#CDEF#REND.

That's it.
After taking several minutes to form words that could have
fit in a single breath, #C120200255Alice#CDEF closes her eyes.

#C120200255Alice#CDEF used all the strength she had
left to leave behind her final words.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF. It's unclear as to what she
was trying to tell us, but please
resume exploring the Labyrinth.

#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF absorbed these girls into her
#ROFS0001#RUBS    heart #RUBELabyrinth#REND to serve as a #RUBS  gimmick#RUBEmechanic#REND.
Releasing them, which is to say that her #C000246204SG#CDEF―
I nod at #C236196003Rani#CDEF's transmission.

I won't waste #C120200255Alice#CDEF's effort.
I'll clear away all the darkness lurking on this floor…!
She doesn't respond when I talk to her.

I assemble the doll parts I gathered
and place it on #C120200255Alice#CDEF's lap.

I can't explain why, but I got the sense
that this was the right way to build it.
This little girl and this doll desire one other.

I'll thank you in place of #RUBS myself#RUBE#C120200255Alice#CDEF#REND, who can no
longer say thanks. Thank you for gathering
#RUBS   me #RUBE#C255045045Alice#CDEF#REND up.

Mhm. Doing everything in #[his][her]# power to
help someone in need without being asked is
what's great about Praetor.

But why do you appear this way, #C236196003Caster#CDEF?
What happened since we last saw you?

The moment we arrived, she was already―――
Ah, well, it's no surprise.
We'll quietly accept your thanks.

This was supposed to be something you carried
out yourself. We just did it in your place,
is all. So, what happened, #C236196003Caster#CDEF?

I'm really freakin' tired, so I'll just quietly
accept your thanks. Even if we WERE too late to
save you, making this a waste of time.

―――So, what's with this sorry sight?
Did you incur #C236196003BB#CDEF's wrath while we
weren't looking?

This wasn't for your benefit. We only fulfilled
the wish of a girl who, even on the verge of
death, sold everything she had for her friend.

If you wish to give thanks, then give as many
thanks as pleases you to your Master
when you two reunite.

What we need to hear is the truth of this floor.
What happened, #C236196003Caster#CDEF?
Did you spit in #C236196003BB#CDEF's face as #C236196003Archer#CDEF did?

That girl only loves herself.
She can only love her own things. That's why she
doesn't trust other people's hearts.

We never thought things would turn out
so horribly, you know? Now #RUBS     I've #RUBE#C120200255Alice#CDEF has#REND been
deprived of the freedom to even dream.

#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF was the one who attacked you, right?
…she only loves her own things… which means
she only loves what she possesses.

Not trusting other people's hearts… that's
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF. I always insisted her affection was
eccentric, but for her to be THIS manic…

Depriving them of their freedom… loving only
#ROFS-001#RUBScherished models#RUBEhuman dolls#REND that can't go against her… hmph.
I'm not surprised #ROFS-003#RUBS   Meltlilith#RUBEthat woman's#REND into that.

#C236196003Melt#CDEF took a liking to #RUBS   me#RUBE#C120200255Alice#CDEF#REND and suddenly
turned #RUBS   me#RUBE#C120200255Alice#CDEF#REND into #RUBSan ornamental doll#RUBEa Plant Doll#REND.

That meanie #C236196003Melt#CDEF selfishly broke #RUBS   me#RUBE#C255045045Alice#CDEF#REND into
lots of parts, turning #RUBS   me#RUBE#C255045045Alice#CDEF#REND into #ROFS0004#RUBS  an amusement#RUBEa hobby item#REND.

It was very demeaning, but thanks to you,
#RUBS     I'm#RUBE#C255045045Alice #CDEF#RENDis back to normal. #RUBS     I'm#RUBE#C255045045Alice #CDEF#RENDis―――
a Servant on the verge of disappearing again.

You're so kind. There's no need to make that
face. #RUBS    We've #RUBE#C236196003Alice#CDEF has#REND always been two dead people.
At some random moment, we'll wake back up.

Hehe. Looks like this bad dream is actually
going to end this time. Farewell, lonely #RUBS   me#RUBE#C120200255Alice#CDEF#REND.
Thank you for playing with #RUBS   me#RUBE#C255045045Alice#CDEF#REND up 'til now.

This is the third time #RUBS     I've#RUBE#C120200255Alice#CDEF has#REND been killed.
Poor, poor, #RUBS   me#RUBE#C120200255Alice#CDEF#REND. But, two of those times
were happy for #RUBS   me#RUBE#C120200255Alice#CDEF#REND.
Someone was there to hear #RUBS Alice's#RUBE#C120200255Alice#CDEF's#REND final wish.

The first time was so lonely in that white
hospital. The second and third time, you were
there to see #ROFS0002#RUBS Alice#RUBE#C120200255Alice#CDEF#REND off with that expression.

That's the only thanks #RUBS  I #RUBE#C255045045Alice#CDEF#REND can give you.
#RUBS  I #RUBE#C255045045Alice#CDEF#REND sneakily stole it―a fragment of
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's mind.

#RUBS      I don't #RUBE#C255045045Alice#CDEF doesn't#REND know what meaning it has.
That thing has no name―――
but I'm sure you can make it complete.

Well, then. Good night, big #[brother][sister]#.
Thanks for not letting #C120200255Alice#CDEF's voice,
a ghost as she was, go unheard.
Like candy, the Servant in the form of a little girl vanishes.

Until the very end, she was elegant―――
She kept a soft and sweet smile on her face.

…you were true to your Master, #C236196003Caster#CDEF. Nursery
rhymes comfort little girls. She didn't leave
her owner alone even in death. Superb.

…no need to mourn. By the time her body was
separated and stored away, #C236196003Caster#CDEF had died
as her Master did.

You were able to call her back, even if
just briefly. That means you did the
right thing.

A reflection cannot exist without a source.
A mirror with nothing to reflect goes back to
being a mere wall.

However, there's no need to mourn. #C236196003Caster#CDEF was
snuggled up with her Master up until the very
end―no, she'll continue to be, forever.

Be quick.
You can still catch up to your owner
if you go now.

Heed this phantom, nestled to that ghost: talk
together, laugh together, vanish hand in hand
off to wherever it is you go to.

Now we have a realistic chance of clearing this floor.
I don't know what the name for this is,
but just having it may make it possible to remove the Shield.

Let's start by #C000246204heading to the Shield#CDEF.
There, we'll do an analysis.
Continue to the next floor?
Continue to the next floor.
Return to the previous floor?
Return to previous floor.
Return to the old school.

Beyond lies the furthest area of the seventeenth
floor, but it appears that a Shield blocks the
way. First, solve the mystery behind #C120200255Alice#CDEF.

Hold, Praetor.
How about we investigate the garden, first?
There's clearly something peculiar about it.

Let's check out the garden, first.
It shouldn't take too much time away
from exploring further.

I told you to take a look at that thing in
the garden. Be good and do as I say.

…no, before I proceed, I need to do something
about these #C000246204doll parts#CDEF I got.

I get the feeling that I passed by something
related to this doll on the way here…

Who killed #RUBS   me #RUBE#C120200255Alice#CDEF#REND?
Ring some bells for #C120200255Alice#CDEF's sad parting.
Hey, over here! Hurry and catch up!
We have many more games to play, mister!
We have many more games to play, miss!

Sorry, but my Master's a bit popular.
Find someone else to play with you, Caster.

I said stop, short stuff!!!
We're not even enemies, so listen to us already!

Not only is it a ghost of a ghost, but it's just a husk.
Girl, where did your#RUBS insides#RUBE body#REND fall?

Hurry, hurry!!
#RUBS  I #RUBE#C255045045Alice#CDEF#REND will get away!

There are no signs of #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.
I can infer that she's not on
this floor at present.

Our decoys are working for the time being.
If you ran into #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF now, you'd have
no chance of beating her.

Please wait.
There are signs of a Servant―――
Multiple Servants, confirmed.
A massive number of Servants are on this floor!
A massive number of Servants…!?

Is she saying that there are other Servants
working for #C236196003BB#CDEF apart from #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF?

Is that #C236196003Caster#CDEF!?
What in heaven's name is this?
Has she achieved mass production…!?

…I don't believe my own eyes.
I don't know what trick she's using,
but #C236196003Caster#CDEF has multiplied herself…

I see one, two, three… Agh, it's absurd
counting all these brats. When did this turn
into an elementary school?

It's that #C236196003Caster#CDEF we met a while back.
This doesn't seem to be from a Noble Phantasm
that spawns doppelgangers… What is this?

The enemy readings show they're all #C236196003Casters#CDEF…!?
What the hell is going on!?

This place is supposed to reflect #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's
mind, right? What kind of hobbies does
that girl have!?

Calm yourself, Miss #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF. Their exterior
may be identical, but my readings say their
insides are simply hostile programs.

It doesn't change the fact that they're strong,
but their abilities are inferior to #C236196003Caster#CDEF's.
We have better prospects in battle.

This Servant always did remind me of French dolls,
but seeing so many running around makes
her look even more like a doll.

It's like… a doll house…
If all this has already been set up, then I'd
like to see a proper castle in here…

Ah, no, never mind!
My impressions have nothing to do
with tackling the Labyrinth…

Normally I'd be used to seeing one,
but on this particular floor, it sticks out to me.
There seems to be something here that it doesn't want us
to have!

Mhm. This beast doesn't belong in a little
girl's garden! Let's rout it, Praetor.
I see it's hiding something!

Hmph. Your mug doesn't match this floor.
I see that your holding on to a piece
of #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's secret…!

That there is unmistakably a watchdog.
My ears and nose have detected a
treasure being stored here!

This watchdog is out of place within this
monster's box. #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, let's skewer it
until no trace of it remains!

#C236196003Rani#CDEF, can you detect any more enemies
of that guy's type within this floor?

Yes. I see similar readings… #C000246204Two#CDEF of them left.
They seem to be positioned in every
corner save the northeast.

Okay. If there are only #C000246204two#CDEF left,
then let's get to crushing them.
…don't break those parts, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#C000246204One#CDEF remaining.
After that, it's all up to your assembling
skills, #[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF.
I pick up the last part and line it up with the others.

It's the cruelly disassembled, complete set of a
ball joint doll.

…we need to return that to its #ROFS-002#RUBS Master#RUBEowner#REND.
That little thing doesn't belong to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.
